title: heliotropium fruticosum var. hispidum
intro: Heliotropium fruticosum var. hispidum, commonly known as the "Hispid Heliotrope" or "False Heliotrope", is a plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). Traditionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including its purported ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of Heliotropium fruticosum var. hispidum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
